Report your findings to the client.

initialItems.label: Two Glasses
initialItems.text: The client suspects her husband is seeing someone. Daniel says he is away on business. She has supplied a photograph.

advert.title: A private matter
advert.description: My husband says he is away on business. I would like someone to check his story discreetly. I can supply a photograph. Payment: $150.

message.subject: The photograph I mentioned
message.body:
Detective,

Daniel Reed says this is a work trip. He sent me the attached photograph.

When I asked about the second glass, he said a colleague had joined him. He also says the jacket is his. I have never seen him wear it.

Apparently I am imagining things. Please find out what is actually going on.

Mrs Reed
